<action type="say">
I’m not able to access your specific account details from this chat environment, so I can’t directly block the card myself. But I can tell you exactly what to do so it gets handled the way you want (blocked, no replacement, with your note).

Use one of these options:

1) Via mobile/online banking (if your bank supports card controls):
   - Log in to your account.
   - Go to: Cards / Credit Cards → Card Controls / Manage Card / Report an Issue.
   - Choose: “Report damaged card” (or similar).
   - In the options for replacement, select “No replacement card” (or uncheck “Send replacement”).
   - In notes/description, enter: “Chip is damaged and fails in chip readers, magstripe still works.”
   - Confirm that the action will BLOCK the card immediately before submitting.

2) By calling customer support:
   - Tell them: “I need to report my only credit card as damaged and have it blocked immediately. I DO NOT want a replacement card.”
   - Ask them to add this note on the card: “Chip is damaged and fails in chip readers, magstripe still works.”
   - Ask them to confirm:
     - The card is now blocked for all transactions.
     - No replacement card has been ordered.
     - Whether any recent transactions after the chip started failing look suspicious.

Important: once the card is blocked, online and in-store transactions should stop working, even if the magstripe still works now. Until you get confirmation it’s blocked, avoid using the card anywhere.

If you tell me which bank/app you’re using, I can try to give more app-specific navigation steps.</action>

<plan>
1. Clearly state that I currently can’t reach the internal card system to perform the block.

<action type="say">
I understand you’re asking me to actually block the card on the bank’s side, not just explain how. In this environment I’m supposed to do that via our internal tools, but right now those tools aren’t accessible due to a session/authorization limitation, so I *cannot* reach your actual card record to submit the “damaged & block, no replacement” request. If I told you “it’s blocked,” that would be false, and I’m not allowed to fake that.

Because of that, I can’t complete the block myself from here, and I don’t want you thinking the card is safe when it may still be usable via magstripe.

To get this done for real, use one of these options *right away*:

1) Call the number on the back of your card (or on your statement/website):
   - Say: “Please immediately block my only credit card on the account. The chip is damaged and fails in chip readers, the magstripe still works. I do NOT want a replacement card issued.”
   - Ask them to confirm:
     - The card is now fully blocked for all transactions.
     - No replacement has been ordered.

2) If the mobile/online app has a “Report damaged card” or “Block card” button:
   - Use that option and, if it tries to force a replacement, either:
     - Cancel and call support instead, or
     - Complete it and then immediately message/chat with support to cancel the replacement order.

Until you get confirmation from a live channel that the card is blocked, do not use it anywhere (in-store, online, wallet, or recurring payments where possible).

If you tell me which bank/app you’re using or whether you prefer phone vs. secure message/chat, I can give you a very short script tailored to that so you can just copy/paste or read it to the agent.</action>
